fieldValues.title: Field assignment
fieldValues.description: The entry by which a Type admits one Field: a reference to the Field by id, its declared composition order within the Type, whether it is required before a Record can be logged, and an optional display label. It is the exact boundary between what belongs to the Field and what belongs to the Type — the assignment may say where the Field sits and whether it must be filled, and may never say what it means. `displayLabel` is strictly rendering: needing a materially different label means needing a different Field.
fieldValues.notes: `order` is structure, not presentation. It feeds canonical serialisation and supplies the render default; a View may override it for display.
